name: @encoder-gym/ui
description: Encoder Gym Studio, the local encoder and candidate comparison workspace.

scripts.verify:current: npm run build:backend && npm run build && electron . --verify-managed-current
scripts.start: npm run build:backend && npm run build && electron .
scripts.smoke: npm run build:backend && npm run build:test-fixtures && npm run build && node scripts/smoke.mjs
scripts.verify:agent: npm run build:backend && npm run build:test-fixtures && npm --prefix ../adapters/research-agent-pi run build && npm run typecheck && npm run build && node scripts/agent-journey.mjs
scripts.verify:overview: npm run typecheck && npm run build && electron scripts/verify-overview.cjs
scripts.check: npm run build:backend && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
